actual_bounded_task: Prepare and validate the existing PR review handoff from a real GitHub read.
observation_limits: Current session tool observed and successfully invoked. Local context labels are correlation labels, not authenticated provider/account identity; Doctor validates supplied consistency only.

checks.next_action: Use only the actual host tool under current permission; verify its returned result.

resume_check.next_action: Recover the artifact through the existing owner record, compare its hash, then recheck the exact target and current host authorization. The handoff is not evidence of completion or permission.

timing_limit: The browser journey was not instrumented end-to-end. No reconstructed or synthetic time is presented as observed user performance.
